title: A legal KMS-adjoint output composition selects a reversible compatible auxiliary channel

statement.quantifiers: Every finite faithful sigma-stationary UCP T and actual binary compatible UCP B*, without normality or KMS selfadjointness.
statement.assertion: TSharp=Omega_sigma^-1 T_* Omega_sigma is legal stationary UCP, Gamma=TSharp T is positive compatible KMS-selfadjoint via TSharp composed B*, and one EB Psi satisfies I-Psi<=8(I-Re_KMS T).
assumptions: Faithful reference makes conjugations invertible; actual stationary predual.
KMS C4 applied only to Gamma; no assertion that TSharp alone is compatible.

inputs: Sigma,T,full-domain B* and source C4 comparator.
outputs: One stationary KMS-selfadjoint physical EB comparator for arbitrary stationary T.
interface.precision: Quadratic operator order, not CP order; binary C8.
costs: Adjoint/channel specification, sigma inverse precision and comparator acquisition not free.
Independent review outstanding; existing AZ energy mechanism does not by itself certify this source.

proof_mechanism: KMS adjoint is a positive-conjugation composition of CP maps, unital and stationary.
The explicit joint TSharp composed B* has both marginals Gamma.
obstructions: Heisenberg composition orientation matters; do not assume a weighted adjoint is physical without its formula.
General nonstationary/no-faithful-reference channels and complete-reference bounds are separate.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Use a legal compatible transformed channel to select one comparator, then compare original energy with an exact positive square.

review.source_reported: Source claims complete derivation subject to standard Lieb import; independent verification explicitly outstanding; no separate audit or finite-check receipt supplied; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
